newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Nomura to pay in CZK 12 bln for Czech IPB majority.
newsitem.headline: Nomura to pay in CZK 12 bln for Czech IPB majority.

text.p: Nomura Securities Bank Intl. will pay about six billion crowns for a 36 percent stake in the third largest Czech bank, Investicni a Postovni Banka a.s., finance minister Ivan Pilip said on Thursday.
He said Nomura would then further raise IPB's basic capital another six billion crowns to become the bank's majority shareholder.
"This (36 percent state-held) share will be sold for the bourse price from the day of the offer which was 285 crowns... that is ... almost six billion crowns," Pilip told a news conference.
He did not say on which date the bourse price was based.
He said the equity increase would come on top of the purchase price.
The government late Wednesday chose a bid by Nomura over one by Dutch ING Bank in a tender to sell the state shares in IPB.
Asked what total stake Nomura would acquire in IPB after the share purchase and six billion crown equity increase is complete, Pilip said Nomura "should have a majority share".
IPB shares gained seven crowns on the Prague Stock Exchange on Thursday following the news, to close at 243 crowns.
